percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted samples; descriptive, not confidence intervals

bgp-like-ipv4.recipe: exact repository bgp-like PRNG and prefix-length distribution; synthetic, not a routing-table snapshot

ipv4-disjoint.recipe: index*2 as IPv4 /32 for index 0..<1,000,000; matches the repository disjoint corpus

mixed-adjacent.recipe: alternate 500,000 consecutive IPv4 /32 hosts beginning at 0.0.0.0 and 500,000 consecutive IPv6 /128 hosts beginning at 2001:db8::

mixed-disjoint.recipe: exact repository mixed corpus: even index -> IPv4 index*2 /32; odd index -> 2001:db8:(index>>16):(index&65535)::/64

mixed-overlap.recipe: alternate families; every 64th family ordinal emits parent 10.0.0.0/8 or 2001:db8::/32; other records are canonical contained /16,/24,/32 or /48,/64,/128 networks

mixed-permuted.recipe: same records as mixed-disjoint, emitted in index j=(i*104729+7919)%1,000,000 order; multiplier coprime to count

range-derived-mixed.recipe: 500,000 disjoint six-address intervals alternate family; lower=ordinal*16 (plus 2001:db8:: for IPv6); decompose each into /30+/31 or /126+/127 before benchmarking, yielding 1,000,000 common CIDR records
